recommendations.expected_benefit: Root-cause analysis and regression prevention for the files that keep needing fixes.
limitations: Based on the committed tree and history at HEAD. Uncommitted files are not seen.
prerequisites: Choose the most recent recurring defect as the first case.
recommendations.reasoning: Repeated fixes in the same files point to defect classes that were patched without a recorded root cause. A bugfix spec states the defect, the expected behavior, and what must not change. This is an inference from commit labels, not proof of cause.
recommendations.repository_signal: 12 of 19 commits are fix-labelled, and 1 file(s) recur in fixes.
risks: Commit subjects label changes. They do not prove that each one fixed a defect.
recommendations.summary: Use bugfix specs for the recurring defect areas.
recommendations.title: Bugfix specs
recommendations.verification_method: Run the bugfix spec's first task and confirm a regression test is added.

Hook commands run on your machine. Review the command first.

recommendations.title: Hooks
recommendations.verification_method: Save a file through the agent and confirm the hook runs and reports.
